public class p1096g_v5 {
    static final long MOD = 998244353;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        boolean[] used = new boolean[10];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int d = sc.nextInt();
            used[d] = true;
        }
        
        int half = n / 2;
        long[] dp = new long[half * 9 + 1];
        dp[0] = 1;
        
        for (int pos = 0; pos < half; pos++) {
            long[] newDp = new long[half * 9 + 1];
            for (int sum = 0; sum <= half * 9; sum++) {
                if (dp[sum] == 0) continue;
                for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
                    if (used[d]) {
                        if (sum + d <= half * 9) {
                            newDp[sum + d] = (newDp[sum + d] + dp[sum]) % MOD;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            dp = newDp;
        }
        
        long result = 0;
        for (int sum = 0; sum <= half * 9; sum++) {
            result = (result + dp[sum] * dp[sum]) % MOD;
        }
        
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
